title: Two draws at Fallen Mountain
summary: At Fallen Mountain, Hun Miesheng and Xiao Yan agree to settle the war with three matches, best of three, instead of a full-scale war. Xiao Chen confronts Hun Qianmo and mocks him as the man who once begged the Hun Clan chief for mercy. The Pill Tower Ancestor arrives, says the Pill Tower now stands with the Sky Mansion Alliance, and takes Hun Qianmo, a Six-Star Dou Sheng, into a separate space; their fight ends in a draw. In the second match Xiao Chen fights the Soul Demon Elder, who uses the Heavenly Demon Blood Gu and a Soul Gu Frog. Remembering Xiao Xuan, Xiao Chen gives everything to protect the Xiao clan and strikes with Sky Slash, and that match is also a draw. Everything now rests on the third match, between Xiao Yan and Hun Miesheng.
events: Hun Miesheng challenges Xiao Yan, who accepts.
They agree on three matches, best of three.
The Pill Tower Ancestor joins the alliance's side and fights Hun Qianmo to a draw.
Xiao Chen fights the Soul Demon Elder.
Xiao Chen gives everything for the Xiao clan, and the match ends in a draw.
The Hall of Souls side readies Hun Miesheng for the last match.
cultivation: Hun Qianmo is a Six-Star Dou Sheng ('Hun Qianmo's strength is around six stars'). A late Five-Star Dou Sheng aura appears in Xiao Chen's match (1011.2). No change for Xiao Yan.
